_comment: Every input file Chip2Dose reads. `fetch.py` downloads, verifies sha256 and writes provenance.csv. redistribute=true files are cached in this repository; redistribute=false files are fetched at a pinned, immutable URL and never committed.

sources.description: Liver-Chip study, Supplementary Data 1: drug information, human Cmax (total), expected fraction unbound in plasma, chip dosing concentrations (total and free).
sources.citation: Ewart L, et al. Performance assessment and economic analysis of a human Liver-Chip for predictive toxicology. Commun Med 2, 154 (2022). doi:10.1038/s43856-022-00209-1

sources.description: Liver-Chip study, Supplementary Data 8: day-3 albumin, ALT and morphology per concentration for three matched pairs (source data of Figs. 1-2).
Liver-Chip study full text (JATS XML). Table 1 = matched toxic/non-toxic pairs and Garside DILI rank; Table 4 = chip MOS-like values per donor.
FDA DILIrank 2.0: 1,336 FDA-approved drugs with vMost / vLess / vNo / Ambiguous DILI-concern labels.
sources.citation: U.S. FDA, Drug-Induced Liver Injury Rank (DILIrank 2.0) Dataset. https://www.fda.gov/science-research/liver-toxicity-knowledge-base-ltkb/drug-induced-liver-injury-rank-dilirank-20-dataset

sources.description: US EPA MEA network-formation dataset: minimum EC50 across 17 network parameters for 146 test entries, ToxCast comparison and administered equivalent doses (AEDs).
sources.citation: Shafer TJ, et al. Evaluation of chemical effects on network formation in cortical neurons grown on microelectrode arrays. Toxicol Sci 169(2):436-455 (2019). Data: doi:10.23719/1503191
sources.license: US-Government-Work (EPA data are public domain by default)

sources.description: Geci et al. integrated drug table: in-vitro PODs from 17 hepatotoxicity datasets (lowestPOD), Cmax values (medianCmax), clinical dose, DILIrank labels.
sources.citation: Geci R, Sayin AZ, Schaller S, Kuepfer L. Integration of in vitro and in silico approaches enables prediction of drug-induced liver injury. Arch Toxicol 100(5):2029-2046 (2026). doi:10.1007/s00204-026-04305-2 . Data: https://github.com/ReneGeci/DILIprediction
sources.license: Repository has no LICENSE file; the article is CC-BY 4.0 and states the data are published with it. Not redistributed here; fetched at a pinned commit.

sources.description: Geci et al. predicted compound properties: logP (OPERA, VEGA, ADMETLab) and fraction unbound in plasma (OPERA, ADMETLab, Simulations Plus).
sources.citation: Geci R, et al. Arch Toxicol 100(5):2029-2046 (2026). doi:10.1007/s00204-026-04305-2 . Data: https://github.com/ReneGeci/DILIprediction
